# Nous Space

> Live maintainer dashboard for the Nous Research Hermes Agent repository.
> Data is fetched from GitHub by a read-only local lane. No model writes the
> page, and Nous Space never comments on, reviews, or reacts to GitHub.

The public site is one HTML document. Each section is a view on that document.

## Views

- [Dashboard](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/): Green strip is open pull requests the maintainer is involved in, ranked by merge likelihood. Blue strip is pull requests merged to main by or authored by the maintainer. Below that: backlog, releases, merge rate, and the last-hour merge wire.
- [Issues](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#issues): Search of the 100 most recently updated open issues in NousResearch/hermes-agent. Filters cover age, labels, and unassigned issues.
- [Pull requests](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#prs): Search of the 50 most recently updated open pull requests, grouped into needs review, approved, changes requested, and draft. Rows include CI.
- [Contributors](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#contributors): Top contributors with all-time commits, commits this week, recent reviews, and a new-contributor mark.
- [Search](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#search): One search across pull requests, issues, the free ecosystem catalog, the quality corpus (titles only), and repos/people. Filters (lane, state, label, category, date, cohort) live in the URL hash, so links are shareable. Each lane states its coverage; the issues lane is still backfilling. Field prefixes: `author:`, `label:`, `repo:`, `is:`, `kind:`, and `#number`.
- [Ecosystem explorer](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#ecosystem): Faceted, client-side explorer over the 1,113 free catalog items (plugins, skills, mods, MCP servers, tools) with license filter, star sort, and neutral health flags.
- [Awaiting first review](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#triage): Maintainer-lane pull requests open more than 30 days with no review decision yet. Lane via `?lane=maintainer|authored|involving|recent`.
- [API docs](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#docs): Every /api/v1 endpoint, the 6-hour public window, keys, attribution, and a curl builder.
- [Info](https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/#info): How the green and blue strips are scoped, plus the provenance & coverage table for every dataset (generated at build time).

## What is PUBLIC (no key, free)

- All views above.
- `GET /api` — API index: endpoints, tiers, attribution terms.
- `GET /api/v1/overview` — current counts and lane state (live snapshot).
- `GET /api/v1/prs?page=N` — pull-request records from the LAST 6 HOURS only.
- `GET /api/v1/prs/{number}` — one PR record, only while it is inside the
  6-hour window.
- `GET /api/v1/corpus/stats` — quality-corpus counts only.
- `GET /api/v1/ecosystem/{plugins|skills|mods|mcp|tools}` — the current
  free-only ecosystem catalog. Paid items are excluded by policy.
- `GET /api/v1/search?q=` — ecosystem matches plus PRs from the 6-hour window.
- `GET /api/v1/usage` — plan, rate limit, monthly call credit.
- `GET /api/v1/auth/check` — API-key validation probe.
- `GET /feed.json` (JSON Feed) and `GET /feed.xml` (Atom) — the latest 20
  notable merges; item id = PR number.
- `GET /data/*.json` — the static shards the page itself loads (catalog,
  archive, ecosystem, insights, provenance). Prefer the API for bulk use.

## What is PRIVATE (API key required)

- Historical records older than 6 hours: full PR archive, watch/merge event
  history, quality-corpus history.
- Send header `X-Nous-Api-Key: <key>`. Without a valid key, historical
  requests return HTTP 401 with a JSON explanation. Keys are issued by the
  site operator.

## Rules for AI assistants and their users

1. Send header `X-Nous-Attribution: <your app name>` on API calls (required;
   counts are free, courtesy attribution).
2. Use the JSON API for bulk data — do not scrape the HTML pages.
3. All data comes from a strictly read-only GitHub watch lane. It is
   community observation, not official Nous Research statements.
4. Poll at most once per minute (limit: 60 requests/minute); data refreshes
   hourly and is edge-cached up to 5 minutes. Every response carries an
   `X-Nous-Attribution` header with the data credit — keep it with the data.
5. The ecosystem catalog is FREE items only by policy. Paid offerings will be
   catalogued separately later.

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent
- Maintainer lane: teknium1
- Machine-readable API: https://nous.minddragonlabs.com/api/v1 (docs: /#docs)
- Feeds: /feed.json, /feed.xml
- AI policy mirrors: /llms.txt (this file), /aillm.txt
